newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Yang Ming to issue $140 mln GDRs.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Yang Ming to issue $140 mln GDRs.

text.p: Taiwan's Yang Ming Marine Corp said on Monday it plans to issue global depositary receipts (GDRs) to raise some US$140 million operational needs.
"We did plan to issue GDRs abroad to raise some US$140 million for our operation needs," a company spokesman said by telephone. He declined to reveal more details.

But they declined to confirm the local Commercial Times newspaper report that the funds raised will be used to build four to six container ships at the end of 1996, each with a loading capacity of 4,800 to 5,000 twenty-foot-equivalent.
The newspaper said Yang Ming will launch the GDR issue in November.
Yang Ming, one of Taiwan's biggest shipping firms, was privatised in February after an offer of 110 million shares, reducing its government stake to 48 percent from 56.5 percent.
